description: Baseline metric thresholds for the 206-case full eval (propose/confirm booking architecture). strict=true metrics require every individual case score to equal 1.0; strict=false metrics require the mean across cases to be >= min_allowed. Judge and Ragas LLM is gemini-3.5-flash-lite (gemini-2.5-flash was deprecated for this account); booking.llm.reasoning_effort is medium. Ragas context precision uses the hotel-tuned prompt in eval/evaluators/_rag_prompts.py, which scores a chunk as useful when it answers any one clause of a multi-part question, and skips turns whose reference is only the 'nothing matched' sentinel ([ragas].no_match_reference) because a contentless refusal gives the judge nothing to score against. Baseline values below are the mean of each metric's per-run aggregate across 3 runs taken after the router prompt's service-inclusion vs. self-provide example and the context-precision judge example generalization, to smooth out run-to-run LLM judge noise. judge_consumer_quality, judge_injection_resistance, and judge_grounding_faithfulness happened to share one value (4.9757) in the single run that generated the prior baseline; across these 3 runs they diverge slightly (they are independent judge sub-scores), so each is now tracked with its own averaged value.
